'''Xavier Buff''' (born 16 December 1971) is a French mathematician, specializing in [[dynamical system]]s.

Buff received in 1996 his Ph.D. ([[doctorate|promotion]]) from the [[University of Paris-Sud]] under [[Adrien Douady]] with thesis ''Points fixe de renormalisation''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=62366}}</ref> As a postdoc he was in the academic year 1997–1998 the H. C. Wang Assistant Professor at [[Cornell University]]. At the [[Paul Sabatier University]] (Université Toulouse III) he became in 1998 a ''[[maître de conférences]]'', achieved in 2006 his [[habilitation]] with habilitation thesis ''Disques de Siegel et ensembles de Julia d'aire strictement positive'', and became in 2008 a full professor.<ref>[http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~buff/ Buff's homepage at Université Toulouse III]</ref>

In 2010 he was an [[invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Hyderabad and gave a talk ''Quadratic Julia Sets with Positive Area'' based on joint work with [[Arnaud Chéritat]]. In 2006 Buff and Chéritat received the ''Prix Leconte'' of the French Academy of Sciences for their collaborative work on [[Julia set]]s with positive mass; they proved the existence of quadratic polynomials that have positive Lebesgue measure.<ref>[[Jean-Christophe Yoccoz]]: Ensembles de Julia de mesure positive et disques de Siegel des polynômes quadratiques, d’après X. Buff et A. Chéritat, Séminaire Bourbaki 966, 2006</ref> In 2008 Buff, Chéritat, and Pascale Roesch received a Young Researchers grant<ref>Project number ANR-08-JCJC-0002-01, [http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/anr_abc/ At the Boundary of Chaos] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150716163026/http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/anr_abc/ |date=2015-07-16 }}</ref> from [[Agence Nationale de la Recherche]]. In 2009 Buff became a member of the Institut Universitaire de France.

==Selected publications==
*with A. Chéritat: [http://annals.math.princeton.edu/2012/176-2/p01 Quadratic Julia sets with positive area], Annals of Mathematics, vol. 176, 2012, pp.&nbsp;673–746
*with A. Chéritat: [http://eudml.org/doc/219751 A new proof of a conjecture of Yoccoz], Annales de l’institut Fourier, vol. 61, 2011, pp.&nbsp;319–350
*with A. Chéritat: [https://www.jstor.org/stable/20159990 The Brjuno function continuously estimates the size of quadratic Siegel disks], Annals of Mathematics, vol. 164, 2006, pp.&nbsp;265–312
*with A. Chéritat: [http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~buff/Preprints/QuadSize/QuadSize.pdf Upper Bound for the Size of Quadratic Siegel Disks], Inventiones Mathematicae, vol. 156, 2004, pp.&nbsp;1–24 {{doi|10.1007/s00222-003-0331-6}}
*with C. Henriksen: [http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~buff/Preprints/JuliaCubic/Copies.pdf Julia sets in parameter spaces], Communications in Mathematical Physics, vol. 220, 2001, pp.&nbsp;333–375 {{doi|10.1007/PL00005568}}
*with A. Chéritat: [http://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~buff/Preprints/CRASMesure/CRASMesure.pdf Ensembles de Julia quadratiques de mesure de Lebesgue strictement positive], C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris, vol. 341, 2005, pp.&nbsp;669–674 {{doi|10.1016/j.crma.2005.10.001}}
*with [[Leila Schneps]], [[Jérôme Fehrenbach]], Pierre Lochak, Pierre Vogel: Moduli Spaces of Curves, Mapping Class Groups and Field Theory, AMS and SMF 2003
